name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=cast_spell, descriptor=0c_with_prefx. The 0c is the FD2 spell ID 0x0C (spell IDs span 00h-23h, a meaningful domain ID, NOT an address residue) and must be preserved. '_with_prefx' correctly marks that this handler plays a pre-effect (cast SFX + rising pre-cast effect) before delegating to the earthquake worker, distinguishing it from 0xA (basic, no pre-effect). Matches sibling fd2_cast_spell_0b_with_prefx naming scheme. No Ghidra address suffix present.
purpose: Spell dispatch handler for spell_id 0xC (12); plays a cast SFX + rising pre-cast effect, then delegates to the earthquake/screen-shake worker with spell_id 0xC.
logic_summary: Registered as entry index 0xC in the spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01 (xref from 0x51D31, table offset 0x30 = bytes 9e 1a 02 00 = this function). Member of the earthquake family (id 0xA-0xC). (1) fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr, 2, 1) -- generic cast SFX (id 2). (2) fd2_play_rising_pre_cast_effect(caster, 0x1E, 0x10) -- pre-effect with initial=0x1E (30), step=0x10 (16), faster/higher than 0xB's {0xF, 0xA}. (3) fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake(caster, 0xC, n_tgt, tgt_arr). In the binary the third call is a tail JMP to 0x2153B (the shared tail of fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic @ 0x21527), so the raw function has no explicit RET; the src expresses the net effect as a plain call. The leading PUSH 0x14 / CALL __CHK is the Watcom stack-probe prologue.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_0c_with_prefx(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Casting unit ID; forwarded to the rising pre-cast effect and to the earthquake worker as the caster.
params.reason: Descriptive of usage (caster unit), no address residue; consistent with all other handlers in spell.c.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of target units; passed through unchanged to the earthquake worker.
params.reason: Descriptive (number of targets), no address residue; consistent with spell.c convention.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-ID array; passed through unchanged to the earthquake worker.
params.reason: Descriptive (target array pointer), no address residue; consistent with spell.c convention.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the queued cast SFX, pre-effect animation, and earthquake/screen-shake spell execution.

comment_original_issue: src had no dedicated comment above fd2_cast_spell_0c_with_prefx; only the sibling 0xB handler carried an explanatory comment, leaving 0xC's distinguishing pre-effect params (0x1E/0x10) undocumented.
notes: Verified dispatch-table linkage: table @ 0x51D01, entry 0xC at offset 0x30 (bytes 9e 1a 02 00) = 0x21A9E. Siblings confirmed: entry 0xA=0x21527 (fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic), entry 0xB=0x2185F (fd2_cast_spell_0b_with_prefx). Global [0x53b13] = data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr (matches src). Ghidra plate already consistent (correct spell_id, pre-effect params, shared-tail JMP-to-0x2153B mechanism, dispatch xref) -> left unchanged. Only added src comment; no logic touched.
